claim: The fourth authorization stopped before scoring after five valid rows because a transient retry outlived the five-minute Anthropic cache and the required paired cache read was absent.

failure.error: RuntimeError: required Anthropic cache read was not observed

replacement_boundary: Remove the campaign-only cache protocol. Each prefix is reused only once, so a one-hour 2x write plus 0.1x read costs more than two uncached reads, while the five-minute tier cannot survive long requests and retries. Start a clean uncached authorization and do not score or reuse these partial rows.

evidence_contract.claim: The fourth authorization is a prompt-cache lifetime failure and its partial rows are not benchmark evidence.
evidence_contract.notes: Instrument failure only; all five completed partial rows remain score-quarantined.
